auth.notes: Bearer token is the xAI API key (XAI_API_KEY). Confirmed first-party: xai-org/xai-cookbook's official example notebooks instantiate the stock OpenAI client with base_url https://api.x.ai/v1 and the key as a standard Authorization: Bearer header.

notes: Genuinely OpenAI-compatible (/chat/completions-shaped): confirmed by reading xai-org/xai-cookbook (official) notebooks that point the plain `openai` Python client at this base URL, and xai-org/xai-sdk-python's client defaults (api_host api.x.ai). Streaming/tool schema are the standard OpenAI-compat shapes implied by that usage; not exercised against the live API from this environment.

Model ids grok-4.3, grok-build-0.1 and grok-4 were read VERBATIM from the official SDK source (xai-org/xai-sdk-python src/xai_sdk/types/model.py, 2026-07-11). grok-4.5 (announced 2026-07-08) is press-corroborated (TechCrunch, Axios, docs.x.ai search snippets) but is NOT yet in the SDK's model list -- see its per-model note.

grok-code-fast-1 is deliberately ABSENT: xAI retired it (and 7 other slugs) effective 2026-05-15; the slug still resolves but silently redirects to grok-4.3 and bills at grok-4.3's rate (docs.x.ai/developers/migration/may-15-retirement, via search snippets). The current coding-specialized model is grok-build-0.1.

Pricing could not be first-party-verified: every first-party xAI domain (docs.x.ai, x.ai, console.x.ai) returned 403 at the proxy CONNECT layer from this build environment on 2026-07-11. All prices ship null with price_confidence "unconfirmed" so the cost meter reports Unconfirmed/not-Priced rather than a fabricated $0, and PriceTierFor sorts every xai model tier-2 (unpriced) -- last in cost-preference auto-routing. Same discipline as openai.json / zhipu.json.
context/max_output are intentionally omitted for every model: search-snippet figures genuinely conflicted (e.g. grok-4.5 context reported as both 500K and 1M), so they read as unverified fail-closed.

WebSearch snippets consistently reported figures (e.g. grok-4.3 $1.25/$2.50) but per this repo's pricing-verification discipline nothing snippet-only is written as a number. Left null; re-check against docs.x.ai/developers/models from an unblocked network.
verification.capabilities_note: tools:true on grok-4 is first-party-adjacent (xai-org/xai-cookbook's function_calling_101 notebook literally calls model=grok-4 with OpenAI function tools); all other tools/vision flags are search-snippet or inferred -- vision is omitted wherever the evidence was ambiguous (fail-closed).

models.notes: Id read verbatim from the official SDK source. Also xAI's documented fallback target: the eight slugs retired 2026-05-15 silently redirect here and bill at this model's rate. Listed first deliberately -- it is the safest validation probe (most certain to exist). Snippet-reported price $1.25/$2.50 per 1M NOT written per pricing discipline. vision omitted: inferred-only in this research pass.

xAI's current flagship, announced 2026-07-08; corroborated by independent press (TechCrunch, Axios) and docs.x.ai search snippets, but NOT yet present in the official SDK's model list as of 2026-07-11 -- the one id here without verbatim first-party source confirmation. Deliberately not models[0] so key validation never depends on it. Snippet-reported context conflicted (500K vs 1M); omitted. vision:true per snippets of the docs model page (text+jpg/png input).

xAI's current coding-specialized model (underlies the Grok Build CLI; API beta per x.ai/news/grok-build-0-1 via snippets). Id read verbatim from the official SDK source. Supersedes the retired grok-code-fast-1 -- do not re-add that slug. vision omitted: single ambiguous snippet only; plausibly text-only.

Original Grok 4 flagship. Id confirmed both in the official SDK source and used literally (model="grok-4" with function tools) in xai-org/xai-cookbook -- tools:true is the one first-party-adjacent capability flag in this manifest. Its dated variant grok-4-0709 was retired 2026-05-15 (redirects to grok-4.3); the bare id was not on the retirement list. vision:true is well-established xAI messaging, not re-confirmed from a docs page this session.
